instructions: Нижче введіть ідентифікатор сайту інвертора та ключ API моніторингу solaredge. API має обмеження в 300 запитів на день, тому не встановлюйте надто низьке планування. Дані оновлюються лише кожні 15 хвилин на стороні solaredge.
oauthInstructions: 1. Create an account and a Site Access application with scope SITE_DATA in the SolarEdge developer portal. Use the redirect URI below for the application. 2. Enter client id and client secret of the application and save. 3. Open the authorization link, log in and grant access. 4. The browser is redirected to the redirect URI (the page may not load). Copy the complete URL from the address bar into the field below and save. The adapter requests the tokens on the next run. Repeat steps 3 and 4 if the authorization expires.
Must be identical to the redirect URI of: Must be identical to the redirect URI of your SolarEdge app
Copy and open this link in your browser: Copy and open this link in your browser
Paste the complete URL from the browser: Paste the complete URL from the browser address bar after granting access, then save
Filled in automatically from the redirec: Filled in automatically from the redirect URL (OAuth2)
